info.title: CleanNest enquiry API
info.description: Accepts a cleaning enquiry for CleanNest, a cleaning company based in Jalandhar, Punjab, and delivers it to the business. This is the site's only machine interface. It is public but gated by a Cloudflare Turnstile token, so it is intended to be called from the cleannest.in pages rather than by unattended agents, which cannot obtain a token.

post.description: Validates the enquiry and sends it to the business. Values are trimmed and clamped to the documented maximum lengths; control characters are stripped. On success the enquiry has been delivered, and there is no idempotency key — a repeated identical request is a second enquiry.

400.description: `invalid_json` for a malformed or non-object body, `name_required` when name is empty, `phone_invalid` when the phone number is not 10-15 digits after non-digits are stripped.

403.description: `captcha_failed` — the Turnstile token was missing, rejected, or could not be verified.

502.description: `send_failed` — the enquiry passed validation but could not be delivered downstream.

503.description: `not_configured` — captcha verification or delivery is not configured in this deployment.

phone.description: Contact number. Non-digits are stripped, so spacing and punctuation are accepted. A 10-digit number is treated as Indian and prefixed with 91; 10 to 15 digits are required, and the digits are what is delivered.

when.description: Free-text preferred timing, passed through to the business unchanged.

notes.description: Free-text notes. Line breaks are preserved.

services.description: The services the enquiry is about. At most 20 are kept; each is clamped to 80 characters and any that are empty after trimming are dropped.

turnstileToken.description: Cloudflare Turnstile response token. Required — the endpoint rejects the request without a verifiable token.
